topic: retrieval-augmented generation: retrieval, reranking, chunking, evaluation, hallucination
selection: Orchestrator-delegated choice by the coding agent (M7c task): arXiv versions whose abs page AND OAI-PMH arXivRaw record both name CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0 or CC0 1.0 and that are the latest version; short papers (<= 8 pages by the author comment) so the 400-call ceiling fits; 10 that the production parser indexes and 2 it does not, kept to report the real product state.
redistribution: PDFs and full text are NOT in the repository. scripts/m7c_papers.py fetch re-downloads exactly these versions from arXiv and checks SHA-256 and size.
